name: gizza-ai/heic-to-jpg
summary: Convert an Apple HEIC/HEIF photo to JPEG or PNG.

tool.description: Convert an Apple HEIC/HEIF photo to JPEG (default) or PNG. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior image tool call (e.g. "call_42"). Use either url or ref.
